rationale: The proposal is plausible but lacks critical empirical support: immuno-capture and spike-in tracers are unvalidated in very low-biomass lavage/CSF/olfactory matrices; there is no direct demonstration that capture‑positive, detergent/protease‑sensitive EVs are recoverable in vivo and quantitatively correlate with the ex vivo cytokine PD; and downstream fractionation/formulation may destroy the orthogonal signature. Address assay sensitivity/matrix compatibility, per-sample spike‑in recovery, and show process/scale preservations and in vivo recovery correlated with PD (and resolve large-animal biodistribution concerns) before treating this as a mechanism‑linked potency gate.
